title: Treaty Land Atlas: nodes file
description: Validates build/nodes.json. Author: Benjamin Life (@omniharmonic). Draft v0.1 (2026-10-16). Every node carries confidence, provenance, tribal_review and publication; rules in NodeCommonRules enforce the G2/G3 ethics requirements.

Confidence.description: Overall reliability of this record. Seeds that use verified/from-memory/disputed/unverified are mapped (verified->high, otherwise low) and keep the raw value in provenance.source_confidence_raw.

VerificationStatus.description: Brief section 3 tags. 'mixed' = some fields verified and some from memory. 'not_assessed' = the seed gave only high/medium/low.

Flags.description: Machine-detected warnings. Shown as badges in the UI.

Provenance.description: Where this record came from. Required on every node and edge (G2 s.8.1, G3 E3).

source_file.description: Path of the seed/crosswalk file, relative to the repo root.

source_row_id.description: ID or row key in that file.

source_agent.description: Research agent letter (A-G) that produced the seed, taken from the seed README.

source_confidence_raw.description: The confidence string exactly as it appeared in the seed.

research_docs.description: Narrative research files that explain the row, e.g. docs/research/A1-treaty-framework-and-counts.md

built_by.description: Script that emitted the record, e.g. scripts/build_graph.py

TribalReview.description: G3 s.3.3 per-nation review status. Silence is never consent: the default is not_yet_contacted.

scope.description: nation_specific = content about a nation that needs that nation's review before narrative is published; public_record_only = citations to public federal records.

reviewer_role.description: Office or role (not a person's name unless they agree), e.g. 'THPO office'.

Publication.description: What the public site may show. Enforced together with tribal_review by the rules in NodeCommon.

state.description: record_only = citations and public-record facts with a 'not reviewed' banner and no narrative (G3 s.3.3).

DataClass.description: G3 s.2 classes allowed in the open export: P public record, D derived, N names/identifications, R third-party reuse. Classes K (Indigenous knowledge held under agreement) and S (sensitive) are rejected by design: they never enter the open dataset.

ExternalIds.description: Stable identifiers in other systems. Values are strings or arrays of strings.

NodeCommonRules.description: Rules that apply to every node. They turn the G2/G3 ethics requirements into validation failures.

allOf.$comment: No narrative that speaks for a nation unless the nation's authorized body has reviewed it (G3 s.3.3).
A nation-specific node can only be 'published' after review. Before that it is 'record_only' or 'draft'.
Right to decline / withdraw (G3 s.3.1, s.7.2).

label.description: Display name. Endonym first where known and reviewed (G3 s.6).

aliases.description: Other IDs and names (e.g. legacy TLA-S-* ids merged into a stat-* node).

notes.description: Free-text caveats carried from the seed. Never used as the only place a fact is stored.

instrument_type.description: Legal category (brief principle 2). Never merge categories: agreements and executive orders are not treaties.

completeness.description: skeleton = only NARA index fields are filled; seeded = row exists in treaties-seed.csv.

date_proclaimed.description: Not in the seeds yet. G2 s.8.3 requires it for the time slider effective date.

date_ratified_basis.description: Which ratification event the date_ratified refers to.

parties_text.description: Parties exactly as printed in the seed (NARA/Kappler spellings). Never an endonym.

acreage_ceded.description: Acres as stated by a single source. Retained/reserved acreage never goes here.

acreage_basis.description: Source of the figure. Required in spirit whenever acreage_ceded is set.

treaty_era_label.description: Era label from treaties-seed.csv. NOT the same scheme as PolicyEra; see normalization map.

signatory_authority_disputed.description: README gap 10: no seed field yet. null = not assessed.

royce_cession_numbers.description: README gap 11: filled after the USFS attribute table is joined.

allOf.$comment: Context rows must carry the flag so counts never include them as US-Native treaties (README caution 12).

Instrument.description: Treaty/Instrument: a ratified or unratified treaty, a statutory agreement, an executive-order reservation, or a context instrument. Primary key is the legacy TLA id, whose numeric part is the NARA RIT number.

label.description: Display name. Endonym first where known and reviewed (G3 s.6).

aliases.description: Other IDs and names (e.g. legacy TLA-S-* ids merged into a stat-* node).

notes.description: Free-text caveats carried from the seed. Never used as the only place a fact is stored.

entity_kind.description: historical_party = a treaty party as named in NARA/Kappler; present_day_government = a government as named in a seed; collective_scope = a grouping label, not a polity.

federal_recognition.description: What the seeds say, not a determination. Recognition is a legal category and is for the federal government and nations to state.

names.description: Alias list. 'endonym_per_seed' means a seed printed it; it is not a confirmed endonym.

Nation.description: A Native nation, people, band, confederacy or other identified party. Historical party names and present-day governments are SEPARATE nodes joined by 'successor_of' edges with a review status (see H2).

label.description: Display name. Endonym first where known and reviewed (G3 s.6).

aliases.description: Other IDs and names (e.g. legacy TLA-S-* ids merged into a stat-* node).

notes.description: Free-text caveats carried from the seed. Never used as the only place a fact is stored.

geometry_ref.description: ID of a GeoFeature, if any. None in v0.

Place.description: A coarse place: Atlas region, state, or later a reservation/cession area. Never a sacred-site location (G3 s.4).

label.description: Display name. Endonym first where known and reviewed (G3 s.6).

aliases.description: Other IDs and names (e.g. legacy TLA-S-* ids merged into a stat-* node).

violation_types.description: First item is the primary code (B1 s.4). Codes come from the B1 controlled vocabulary.

adjudicated_breach_label_allowed.description: False for CONTEXT_* and ANNEXATION_CONTEXT codes (B1 s.4.4).

year_text.description: violation_year exactly as written in the seed (ranges, decades, serial).

acreage_text.description: Seed text; usually 'not stated in sources read'. Not numeric.

acknowledgment.description: B3 ledger value (Court/Statute/ICC-CoC/Apology/None found). Not in the seed yet.

evidence_flags.description: G2 s.4 evidence categories. Empty until assigned with citations.

allOf.$comment: Context codes must not be presented as adjudicated breaches (B1 s.4.4).

Violation.description: A documented violation, abrogation, diminishment or taking, tied to an instrument by edges, not by free text.

display_eligible.description: True only when confidence is high or medium (F README rule).

allOf.$comment: Donation integrity (brief principle 6; F4): low-confidence organizations are tracking rows, not public recommendations.

Organization.description: An organization, tribal government body, program or agency. A tribal government is an Organization linked to a Nation by 'governing_body_of'.

Source.description: A source cited by a record: a URL, a dataset from the E inventory, a book or a legal text.

Person.description: Reserved. Not populated in v0. Only deceased, historically public figures when an edge cannot be expressed another way.

boundary_description_text.description: Verbatim from the treaty article (G2 s.9.2).

geometry_file.description: Path of the GeoJSON/TopoJSON file that holds the coordinates.

allOf.$comment: T4 = no usable geometry: the record is a schematic card and carries geometry_file 'none'.

GeoFeature.description: A polygon (or schematic stand-in) with the full lineage record from G2 s.8.1. No instances in v0; the Royce/USFS join is a later step.

Node.description: Any node. 'type' selects exactly one definition.

nation_ids.description: Semicolon-separated Nation ids, or NONE for a blocker row (text that is consumed so a shorter alias cannot match inside it).
